title: Beyond Outcome Feedback: Trajectory-Quality-Guided Experience-based Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Experience-based learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve over time by reusing knowledge from past executions. However, existing methods typically rely on final task outcomes as feedback for experience learning, overlooking the execution process and limiting their ability to evaluate and optimize experience based on trajectory quality. To address this limitation, we propose TQG-Exp, a trajectory-quality-guided experience-based learning framework that introduces process feedback. Specifically, we introduce Trajectory Quality Loss (TQL), which jointly considers task completion and process quality to provide a learning signal beyond final task outcomes. Based on this signal, we employ paired rollouts with and without retrieved experience to guide experience optimization. Representative trajectories are selected based on their outcomes and trajectory quality to extract task-level and task-type-level experiences. Meanwhil

translated_title: 超越结果反馈：基于轨迹质量引导的经验学习
translated_abstract: 基于经验的学习使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够通过复用过去执行中的知识来不断提升。然而，现有方法通常仅依赖最终任务结果作为经验学习的反馈，忽视了执行过程，从而限制了基于轨迹质量来评估和优化经验的能力。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了TQG-Exp，一个轨迹质量引导的基于经验的学习框架，引入了过程反馈。具体而言，我们提出了轨迹质量损失，它联合考虑任务完成度与过程质量，从而提供超越最终任务结果的学习信号。基于该信号，我们采用有无检索经验的成对推演来引导经验优化。根据结果和轨迹质量选出代表性轨迹，用以提取任务级和任务类型级的经验。同时（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TQG-Exp框架，通过引入轨迹质量损失（TQL）将过程质量反馈与最终任务结果相结合，从而更有效地评估和优化LLM智能体的经验学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes TQG-Exp, a trajectory-quality-guided experience-based learning framework that introduces Trajectory Quality Loss (TQL) to combine process feedback with final task outcomes for evaluating and optimizing LLM agents' experience learning.
